title: Banks Act Directive D5/2025 — Returns to be submitted to the Prudential Authority
enablingLegislation: Section 6(6)(a) of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990)

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
1.              Introduction

1.1             Sections 105 and 108 of the Financial Sector Regulation Act, 2017 (Act No. 9 of
                2017) (FSRA), read with the Banks Act, make provision for the PA to make
                prudential standards and determinations for financial institutions in respect of
                various matters, including matters in respect of which regulations may be
                prescribed in terms of the Banks Act.

1.2             Towards the end of 2023, as an integral part of the Umoja System Implementation
                Project,1 the Umoja team commenced engagements with various key persons in
                respect of regulatory return developments and the submission of future returns
                to the PA.


1 The Umoja System is a digital interface between the PA and regulated institutions aimed at providing a more

integrated, efficient and transparent operating model.
                                                                                                          1

1.3          On 11 September 2024, the PA issued Directive 4 of 2024,2 informing all
             interested persons that, to facilitate and support the ongoing work related to the
             Umoja System Implementation Project, the PA had decided to:

1.3.1        recommend to the Minister of Finance and National Treasury that all BA returns
             and related instructions for the completion of the BA returns be deleted from the
             Regulations; and

1.3.2        issue all BA returns and related instructions for the completion of the BA returns
             as an integral part of the directives issued in terms of the Banks Act and/or
             determinations issued under prudential standards in terms of the FSRA.

1.4          On 31 January 2025, the Minister of Finance amended the Regulations by
             deleting from the Regulations all BA returns and related instructions for the
             completion of the BA returns, with effect from 1 February 2025.

1.5          Simultaneously, on 31 January 2025, the PA issued Directive 1 of 2025,3 directing
             banks to complete and submit specified financial, risk-based and other related
             returns to the PA in accordance with the requirements specified in
             Directive 1 of 2025, with effect from 1 February 2025.

sections.heading: Directive
sections.text:
2.           Directive

2.1          Based on the aforesaid, and in accordance with the provisions of section 6(6) of
             the Banks Act, banks are hereby directed as follows:

2.1.1        Submit to the PA the respective financial, risk-based and other returns specified
             in Annexure 1A of this Directive, in accordance with the respective requirements
             specified in Annexure 1A, read with the relevant requirements specified in the
             Regulations.

2.1.2        As specified in regulation 4 of the Regulations, read with the relevant
             requirements specified in Annexure 1A of this Directive, every set of returns
             submitted to the PA shall be accompanied by a duly completed, signed and
             certified:

2.1.2.1      form BA 099, attached to this Directive as Annexure 1B, in the case of returns
             submitted to the PA by a bank or controlling company; and

2.1.2.2      form BA 099A, attached to this Directive as Annexure 1C, in the case of a return
             submitted to the PA in respect of any relevant foreign operation.

2.1.3        Complete form BA 100, attached to this Directive as Annexure 2A, in accordance
             with the requirements specified in Annexure 2B of this Directive, read with the
             relevant requirements specified in the Regulations.

2.1.4        Complete form BA 110, attached to this Directive as Annexure 3A, in accordance
             with the requirements specified in Annexure 3B of this Directive, read with the
             relevant requirements specified in the Regulations.

         from 1 July 2025.

3.2.2        paragraph 2.1.24 to paragraph 2.1.28 of this Directive, with effect from
             1 February 2025.

sections.heading: Acknowledgement of receipt
sections.text:
4.           Acknowledgement of receipt

4.1          Kindly ensure that a copy of this Directive is made available to your institution’s
             external auditors. The attached acknowledgement of receipt duly completed and
             signed by both the chief executive officer of the institution and the said auditors
             should be returned to the PA at the earliest convenience of the aforementioned
             signatories.




Fundi Tshazibana
Chief Executive Officer

Date: 30-Jun-2025

Encl.: 50

The previous Directive issued was Directive 4/2025, dated 30 June 2025.
